I can't give you that name. It isn't in #coastal-team, in any public file, or in anything else you can see. The only thing I have on Driftmoor's night dispatch is that engineering sent a manual CSV patch to the night dispatcher after the Terminal B tide-table import macro failed. The sources don't name the person.

Kwame is the one to ask. He can give you the contact directly, or tell me he's happy for it to be shared. I'll also need the address he uses for them. I don't have an email for them. Because they're outside pemberline.com, Ruth Calloway has to approve any mail to them, including a draft. If you send me the address once you have it, I can sort that out with her.
